- San Diego Rockets (NBA, 1967-1971)

- San Diego Gulls (AHL/WHL hockey)
- San Diego Sockers (Soccer)

Similarly, the San Diego Padres (MLB) have never played in the Sports Arena either, using baseball-specific ballparks instead.
